submission_history.what_changed_vs_prior_submission: One fix, commit 1086c7e7cc: the scored kernel now sets CARNOT_ARC_E3_DIR to a writable path. E3_DIR defaulted to REPO/results/arc_e3 with REPO derived from __file__, which on Kaggle resolves inside the read-only dataset mount, so EVERY induction raised OSError(30, 'Read-only file system') at the persist step -- AFTER the LLM had generated the full world model (310k-485k tokens per game, 99.8% of wall clock). The engine was discarded and each game played on with no world model. Measured on the Blackwell card over ar25/tr87/tu93, all three games, every attempt.
